requirements.statement: An employee can submit an expense claim with amount, category, date, and a receipt.

criteria.must: A signed-in employee can open a new claim form
Submitting a claim with amount, category, date and a receipt attached creates the claim
Submitting a claim without a receipt attached is refused
The category must be chosen from the predefined list

requirements.statement: An employee can see the status of every claim they have submitted.

criteria.must: An employee's claims list shows each claim's status (pending, approved, or rejected)
An employee sees only their own claims, not other employees' claims

requirements.statement: An employee can edit and resubmit a claim their manager rejected.

criteria.must: A rejected claim can be opened for edits by the employee who submitted it
Resubmitting an edited rejected claim returns it to pending status for manager review

requirements.statement: A manager can see the pending expense claims submitted by their direct reports.

criteria.must: A manager's pending-approvals list shows claims submitted by their direct reports
A manager does not see pending claims from employees who are not their direct reports

requirements.statement: A manager can approve or reject a pending claim.

criteria.must: A manager can approve a pending claim, changing its status to approved
A manager can reject a pending claim, changing its status to rejected

requirements.statement: Finance can see every approved claim that has not yet been exported.

criteria.must: Finance's approved-claims list shows only approved claims not yet included in an export

requirements.statement: Finance can export a batch of approved claims to a downloadable file for payroll upload.

criteria.must: Finance can select a set of approved claims and trigger an export
The export produces a downloadable file (e.g. CSV) containing the selected claims

requirements.statement: Claims are marked as exported once included in a payroll batch, so they cannot be exported twice.

criteria.must: A claim included in an export batch is marked as exported
An exported claim no longer appears in the list of claims available for export

requirements.statement: Employees and managers receive an email notification when a claim's status changes.

criteria.must: An email notification is sent to the manager when an employee submits a claim
An email notification is sent to the employee when their claim is approved or rejected
